`articles.jsonl` is a 50-document mini corpus (science, geography, history) used by RAGantine unit/component tests and the CI smoke benchmark.
All article text is original hand-written prose, not copied from Wikipedia or any other source; facts are limited to widely cited figures.
The file is generated by `make_articles.py` (run `python3 tests/fixtures/mini_corpus/make_articles.py` from the repo root); doc_ids are `sha1(source_uri)[:16]`.
Source tiers: 35 curated, 7 partner, 5 web, 3 user_upload.
